name: 67501 · Hutchinson, KS
findings: ZIP 67501 (Hutchinson) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67501 (Hutchinson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67501 (Hutchinson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
